EXT.evidence: He withdraws from the interaction, saying he has to go now and leaving instead of engaging further.

AGR.evidence: He scolds with “What were you thinking?”, rejects the comparison as totally different, and asserts he doesn’t need a reason to leave—confrontational and dismissive.

CON.evidence: He claims a jam-packed schedule and being late, but there is no concrete behavior showing organization or carelessness.

NEU.evidence: He stammers (“You-you had what?”) and becomes uncomfortable, then abruptly leaves—signs of nervousness.

OPN.evidence: He refuses the analogy (“nothing like us,” “totally different situation”), showing little openness to another perspective.
